# Audexa

> Audexa turns any topic you pick into an AI-generated audio briefing: a podcast-style show with two AI hosts discussing the subject, produced in under 2 minutes.

## What it does

- Pick any topic — from world news to niche interests — and get an audio episode generated by AI, with two distinct AI voices discussing it in a podcast-style format.
- Bookmark topics to receive personalized daily audio briefings.
- Free to start, with an ad-free premium tier offering offline downloads and premium AI voices.

## Who it's for

Anyone who wants to listen to news or research on a topic instead of reading it — commuters, multitaskers, and people who prefer audio-first information.

## Key pages

- https://audexa.app/ — landing page
- https://audexa.app/auth — sign in / sign up
- https://audexa.app/about — app overview and mobile app download links
- https://audexa.app/episodes — episode dashboard (requires sign-in)
